notes.design: A gun on a turret or vehicle (slot 0: never carried or picked up). It runs on heat, so a gunner never reloads but has to pace the trigger. The Arc Turret's locked arc (mounts.ts ArcSentrySpec): a hit every 0.1 s while it holds the lock, never a miss, but only after a 0.75 s wind-up and only while it can see you. 50 a second: 100 health is 20 hits, 1.9 s of arc (2.65 s in the open from when it starts charging); a 2 s lock does 100 at most, then it vents 1.25 s.
